DIV5.HEAD: PART 1229—SAFETY STANDARD FOR INFANT BOUNCER SEATS

DIV8.HEAD: § 1229.1 Scope.
DIV8.P: This part establishes a consumer product safety standard for infant bouncer seats.

DIV8.HEAD: § 1229.2 Requirements for infant bouncer seats.
DIV8.P: Each infant bouncer seat must comply with all applicable provisions of ASTM F2167-22, Standard Consumer Safety Specification for Infant Bouncer Seats, approved on approved May 1, 2022. The Director of the Federal Register approves this incorporation by reference in accordance with 5 U.S.C. 552(a) and 1 CFR part 51.
